No. The door admission is separate, and is paid in advance. In addition to the door admission there is a one drink minimum per person. This includes soft drinks, juices, and bottled water. description.value: Village Vanguard is a jazz club at Seventh Avenue South in Greenwich Village and the oldest operating jazz club in New York City. Shows start at 8:00 p.m. and 10:00 p.m. There is a one drink minimum per person, and the club serves no food.
